dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there a lot of smuggling going on?

dialogues.speaker: Shayan
dialogues.text: This is Sumeru City's small port. Since it's right under the Akademiya's nose and is garrisoned by the Corps of Thirty, it's much easier to deal with smuggling problems here than at Port Ormos.

dialogues.speaker: Shayan
dialogues.text: But there will always be a handful of people who don't have their heads on straight and try to pull a fast one here.

dialogues.speaker: Shayan
dialogues.text: Hmph. I'd urge them to really think it through first.
